quote: I am Warhol. I am the number 1 most impactful artist of our generation. I am Shakespeare in the flesh.
source: Sway in the Morning radio interview, 26 Nov 2013
note: Same interview as 'You ain't got the answers, Sway!'

quote: My music is best understood by children and animals.

answer.name: Igor Stravinsky
answer.alias: The composer whose ballet caused a riot in Paris

source: The Observer, 8 Oct 1961
note: The Rite of Spring premiere (1913) ended with fistfights in the audience.

quote: I eat only white foods: eggs, sugar, grated bones, the fat of dead animals; veal, salt, coconut...
source: Memoirs of an Amnesiac (1913), quoted in Rollo Myers, Erik Satie
note: The list goes on: chicken cooked in white water, fruit mould, and skinless fish.

quote: I played over the music of that scoundrel Brahms. What a giftless bastard!

answer.name: Pyotr Ilyich Tchaikovsky
answer.alias: The guy who wrote The Nutcracker

source: Diary entry, 9 Oct 1886
note: They later met, got drunk together, and still didn't like each other's music.

quote: I care very little for Salzburg and not at all for the archbishop: I shit on both of them.
source: Letter to his father Leopold, 12 July 1783
note: Salzburg now sells Mozart chocolates on every corner.

quote: A composer is a guy who goes around forcing his will on unsuspecting air molecules, often with the assistance of unsuspecting musicians.
source: The Real Frank Zappa Book (1989)

quote: I'll play it and tell you what it is later.
source: Spoken on tape at a 1956 Prestige recording session (Relaxin')
note: The line is still audible at the start of the record.

quote: The internet's completely over.
source: Interview, Daily Mirror, 5 July 2010
note: He added that the internet was 'like MTV'. He had a point about MTV.

quote: I'm an instant star. Just add water and stir.
source: Quoted in Rex Reed, Valentines & Vitriol (1978)

quote: I'm for anything that gets you through the night, be it prayer, tranquilizers, or a bottle of Jack Daniel's.
source: Playboy interview, Feb 1963

quote: My week beats your year.
source: Liner notes, Metal Machine Music (1975)
note: The album is 64 minutes of guitar feedback. He meant it as a compliment to himself.

quote: I think of a pessimist as someone who is waiting for it to rain. And I feel completely soaked to the skin.
source: Interview, The Daily Telegraph, 26 Apr 1993

quote: Bob is not authentic at all. He's a plagiarist, and his name and voice are fake. Everything about Bob is a deception.
source: Interview, Los Angeles Times, 22 Apr 2010
note: She later said the journalist was 'a moron' and that she likes a lot of Bob's songs.

quote: I snorted my father. He was cremated and I couldn't resist grinding him up with a little bit of blow.
source: Interview with Mark Beaumont, NME, Apr 2007
note: His manager said it was a joke. His 2010 memoir confirmed it, minus the cocaine.

quote: I'd rather be dead than sing Satisfaction when I'm 45.
source: People magazine, 'The Jaggers', 9 June 1975
note: He sang it at 45. And at 80.

quote: One has to completely humiliate oneself to be what the Beatles were.
source: Rolling Stone interview ('Lennon Remembers'), 1970

quote: Break windows, smoke cigars, and stay up late.
source: Advice to young musicians, Musician magazine, Oct 1987

quote: How Can Mirrors Be Real If Our Eyes Aren't Real
source: Tweet, 2 May 2013
note: He was 14. He later said it was based on a study about visual perception.

quote: We Spice Girls are true Thatcherites. Thatcher was the first Spice Girl, the pioneer of our ideology – Girl Power.
source: Interview with Simon Sebag Montefiore, The Spectator, Dec 1996
note: Mel C's 2022 verdict on whether Thatcher was the first Spice Girl: 'Abbbbbsolutely not!'

quote: First of all, let's get one thing straight. Crack is cheap. I make too much money to ever smoke crack.
source: ABC Primetime interview with Diane Sawyer, 4 Dec 2002
note: The follow-up line was 'Crack is wack.'

quote: I feel like this year is really about, like, the year of just realizing stuff.
source: 'Kylie Up Close' video, Jan 2016
note: She was 18 and about to become a billionaire, so, fair.

quote: Kim, there's people that are dying.
source: Keeping Up with the Kardashians, season 6 (Bora Bora episode), 2011
note: Kim had lost a $75,000 diamond earring in the ocean. Kylie found it.

quote: In my world, you can be a gangsta with a dress or you can be a gangsta with baggy pants. I feel like there's no such thing as gender.
source: Calvin Klein Fall 2016 campaign video
note: He wore a periwinkle dress on the cover of his mixtape the same year.

quote: Real G's move in silence like lasagna.
source: Lyric, '6 Foot 7 Foot' (Tha Carter IV), 2011
note: The G in lasagna is silent. In 2024 the line stumped all three Jeopardy! contestants.

quote: I don't go tanning-tanning anymore because Obama put a 10 percent tax on tanning. And I feel like he did that intentionally for us.
source: Jersey Shore season 2 promo, MTV, June 2010
note: PolitiFact rated it True. John McCain tweeted that he would never tax her tanning bed.

quote: Truly inspiring to be able to come here. Anne was a great girl. Hopefully she would have been a Belieber.
source: Anne Frank House guestbook, Amsterdam, 12 Apr 2013
note: The museum defended him: 'We think he meant it well. He's only 19 years old.'

quote: My cousin in Trinidad won't get the vaccine cuz his friend got it & became impotent. His testicles became swollen. His friend was weeks away from getting married, now the girl called off the wedding.
source: Tweet, 13 Sept 2021
note: Trinidad's health minister said officials 'wasted so much time' checking the claim.

quote: Honestly, I think we should just trust our president in every decision that he makes and we should just support that.
source: CNN Crossfire interview with Tucker Carlson, 3 Sept 2003
note: The clip ended up in Fahrenheit 9/11. She won a Razzie for it.

quote: I hate Americans. I hate America.
source: Security-camera video in a Lake Elsinore doughnut shop, 4 July 2015
note: Said on Independence Day, while licking doughnuts she had not paid for.

quote: Is this chicken, what I have, or is this fish? I know it's tuna, but it says chicken... by the sea.
source: Newlyweds: Nick and Jessica, MTV, 2003
note: Chicken of the Sea later hired her to sing their jingle.

quote: Kim, you're doing amazing, sweetie.
source: Keeping Up with the Kardashians S1E4 'Birthday Suit', 4 Nov 2007
note: Said while photographing her daughter's nude Playboy shoot. She later trademarked it.

quote: Monsieur Wagner has good moments, but awful quarters of an hour!

answer.name: Gioachino Rossini
answer.alias: The guy who wrote the William Tell Overture

source: Letter to Emile Naumann, April 1867

quote: O you miserable scoundrel, what I shit is better than anything you ever thought.
source: Margin note on a critic's review in his copy of Cäcilia, Aug 1825
note: The critic, Gottfried Weber, had panned Wellington's Victory.

quote: Time is a great teacher, but unfortunately it kills all its pupils.

answer.name: Hector Berlioz
answer.alias: The composer of the Symphonie fantastique

source: Letter, November 1856

quote: I have nothing to say and I am saying it and that is poetry as I need it.

answer.name: John Cage
answer.alias: The composer of 4'33" (four and a half minutes of silence)

source: 'Lecture on Nothing', 1949

quote: Nobody can open any roofs? The helicopters flying in take two people at a time, take a kayak. Go into those walls.
source: Larry King Live Hurricane Katrina special, CNN, 3 Sept 2005
note: Said live from her Las Vegas dressing room, right after donating a million dollars.

quote: Oh, some are about four minutes; some are about five, and some, believe it or not, are about eleven or twelve.
source: Playboy interview, Feb 1966, asked what his songs are about
note: He won the Nobel Prize in Literature fifty years later.

quote: He's the real 'Make America Great Again,' because if it wasn't for him, old people wouldn't even get Social Security.
source: GQ profile, April 2018, on Franklin D. Roosevelt
note: Bernie Sanders tweeted 'Cardi B is right.'

quote: I want to thank me for believing in me, I want to thank me for doing all this hard work.
source: Hollywood Walk of Fame acceptance speech, 19 Nov 2018
note: He closed the speech by calling himself a bad motherfucker.

quote: Get your fucking ass up and work. It seems like nobody wants to work these days.
source: Variety video interview, 9 March 2022, 'best advice for women in business'
note: She later said she was having an 'off day'.

quote: They tried to get me to hate white people, but someone would always come along and spoil it.

answer.name: Thelonious Monk
answer.alias: The jazz pianist who wrote 'Round Midnight'

source: Advice to saxophonist Steve Lacy, written in Lacy's notebook, 1960
note: Same list of advice includes 'Always leave them wanting more.'

quote: I have done an in-depth study of drug abuse and Communist brainwashing techniques and I am right in the middle of the whole thing where I can and will do the most good.
source: Handwritten letter to President Nixon, 21 Dec 1970
note: He asked to be made a Federal Agent at Large. Nixon gave him a badge.

quote: The apocalypse is well on its way. This song sucks.
source: The Red Hand Files #218, Jan 2023, on a ChatGPT song written in his style
note: He also called it a grotesque mockery of what it is to be human.

quote: You shouldn't let poets lie to you.
source: Icelandic TV segment, c. 1988, after dismantling a television set
note: A poet had told her TV hypnotizes you. She checked in a Danish book.

quote: I would rather eat my own testicles than reform The Smiths.
source: Uncut magazine, March 2006, turning down a reunion offer
note: He is a vegetarian.

quote: I'm not having hip-hop at Glastonbury. No way. No. It's wrong.
source: BBC interview, April 2008, on Jay-Z headlining
note: Jay-Z opened his set by singing Wonderwall.

quote: Wu-Tang is for the children.
source: Interrupting Shawn Colvin's acceptance speech, Grammy Awards, 25 Feb 1998
note: He had bought an expensive outfit expecting Wu-Tang to win.

quote: AI is actually the fastest path to communism.
source: TikTok video, June 2021
note: She was dating the world's richest capitalist at the time.

quote: Hahahahahahaha How The Fuck Is Cyber Bullying Real Hahahaha...
source: Tweet, 31 Dec 2012
note: His advice: just walk away from the screen.

quote: I wouldn't say a single word to them. I would listen to what they have to say, and that's what no one did.
source: Bowling for Columbine (2002), asked what he would say to the Columbine students
note: His music had been blamed for the shooting.

quote: Let's just say I was with somebody once and I saw a transformation that I can't explain.
source: The Howard Stern Show, Oct 2017, on meeting a shapeshifter
note: He insisted he was totally sober. The shapeshifter was, he later implied, naked.

quote: Hope I die before I turn into Pete Townshend.
source: BAM magazine interview, 10 Jan 1992
note: Townshend wrote "Hope I die before I get old." Only one of them did.

quote: Today marks the 37th Anniversary since I bit a head off a f*cking bat! Celebrate with this commemorative plush with detachable head.
source: Tweet, 20 Jan 2019
note: The $40 plush sold out. He got rabies shots in 1982.

quote: He has a woman's name and wears makeup. How original.
source: On Marilyn Manson, quoted in Celebrity Diss and Tell (2005)
note: Alice Cooper is a man who wears makeup.

quote: I think I know it all, relatively speaking.

answer.name: Gene Simmons
answer.alias: The KISS bassist with the tongue

source: Esquire, "What I've Learned", July 2002
note: Same interview: "You can't buy love with money."

quote: The only rule is don't be boring and dress cute wherever you go. Life is too short to blend in.
source: Confessions of an Heiress (2004), p. 53
note: The line is in the Oxford Dictionary of Quotations.

quote: I may not be a first-rate composer, but I am a first-class second-rate composer.

answer.name: Richard Strauss
answer.alias: The composer of the 2001: A Space Odyssey fanfare

source: Quoted in Michael Kennedy, Richard Strauss (1995), p. 111
note: His Ten Golden Rules for conductors: never look encouragingly at the brass.

quote: I am of another dimension. I am on this planet because people need me.

answer.name: Sun Ra
answer.alias: The jazz bandleader who said he was from Saturn

source: A&M Records press release, 1989
note: He maintained the Saturn story for about fifty years.

quote: Fuck the sea. I ain't going in that. Fuck that, mate. That ain't meant for us.
source: Noisey (Vice) interview, Aug 2017
note: Same interview: modern buildings look like they came out of a Kinder Egg.

quote: What a lovely voice, but who cares?
source: On hearing a Renata Tebaldi recording; Rasponi, The Last Prima Donnas (1982)
note: Tebaldi was her great rival. Callas said the comparison was champagne versus Coca-Cola.

quote: If you don't 'sell out,' guess what? An asshole will.
source: 24 Hours of Love, MTV2 special, 21 Sep 2005
note: Same special: "We choose convenience over individuality every time."
